nodes.plm_action: Cut fabric using a ruler
nodes.plm_caption:
A woman wears a dress made from floral cloth, and a sewing process demonstrates how to make such a dress. The woman measures, cuts out pattern pieces, folds them, and sews them together. She pins the pieces in place and cuts off the extra fabric. She uses an overlock machine and ties bows around the dress. When finished, she dances in the dress.
The woman stands and then her movements become blurred, before she cuts fabric, measures the fabric, and cuts a piece off. She aligns pieces, and pins the garment on the floor. As she sits to sew, the fabric unrolls, and then it is stitched. The fabric is sewn and pinned, and she cuts an opening for the dress zipper. She stands and dances.
A woman and the dress are against a grey fence and background. The woman wears brown heeled shoes, and she is wearing sunglasses, even though they are out of focus. When the dress is sewn, we see the needle through the fabric, and the top piece of the dress is pinned. A few bow ribbons are also on the floor. There is a white text graphic in the end. The dress appears to be in good condition.

summary.brief: A woman measures, cuts, sews and finishes an Ankara mini‑circle skirt and then models it.
summary.detailed: The video opens with the woman standing in front of a grey fence while holding the completed floral mini‑circle skirt. She moves to a tabletop where sewing supplies—including scissors, pins, a measuring tape, a zip and a hook‑and‑eye fastener—are displayed. She measures her waist around her belly button, folds a length of Ankara fabric in half, draws a quarter‑circle on the folded edge and cuts along the line. When the fabric is unfolded it forms a full circle, and she trims the lower part to create an opening for the waistband. She folds the raw edges, pins them together and stitches the side seams with a sewing machine, using an over‑lock stitch. An elastic band is threaded through the waistband, a zip is positioned a centimetre from the edge and sewn in, and a hook‑and‑eye fastener is added for extra closure. The bottom edge is hemmed and decorative bows are attached from leftover fabric. Finally, the woman walks, twirls and dances wearing the finished skirt before the video ends with closing graphics and credits.

action.detailed: Measure the waist, cut a quarter‑circle on folded fabric, unfold to a full circle, trim the lower edge for the waistband, fold and pin the edges, stitch the side seams, insert elastic into the waistband, sew in a zip and a hook‑and‑eye fastener, hem the bottom, and then model the finished skirt.
action.actor: a woman

The video features a woman demonstrating how to make a dress from a t-shirt. While there is no dialogue, there are captions describing each step of the process. The video consists of several title cards, multiple close-up shot of hands performing various tasks, and a final shot of a finished dress being worn by a woman. The video takes place primarily indoors, with an outdoor scene at the beginning and a few brief shots of the woman's shoes at the end. The video is mostly handheld, with the camera moving throughout. There are several editing cuts throughout the video. The footage is primarily low resolution and appears to be from multiple different cameras.
The video starts with a short introduction showcasing the materials needed for the craft. The woman is then shown measuring out the length of the waist with a tape measure before cutting the skirt and then sewing it together.
The video ends with a short transition to a different scene showing a woman modeling a completed dress.

summary.brief: A woman measures, cuts, and sews fabric to create a mini circle skirt, then models the finished piece.
summary.detailed: The video opens with a quick outdoor clip of the finished skirt being twirled, then shifts to a workspace where the presenter lays out Ankara fabric, folds it lengthwise, measures her waist and marks a quarter‑circle radius on the fabric, cuts away the lower half‑circle and opens the circle to form the skirt panels, cuts a matching strip for the waistband, sews the side seams together on a sewing machine, inserts elastic into the waistband, pins and secures the waistband, attaches a zipper near the edge and adds a grommet for extra closure, hems the bottom edge, and finishes by twirling and dancing in the completed mini circle skirt.

action.detailed: Measure the waist, fold and mark the fabric, cut the quarter‑circle pieces, pin the edges, stitch the side seams, insert elastic into the waistband, pin and sew the waistband, attach a zipper and a grommet, hem the bottom, then model the finished skirt.

nodes.plm_action: Cut fabric with scissors and tape measure
nodes.plm_caption:
In a sped-up, continuous shot, the video shows a woman wearing a skirt as she twirls around to display it from various angles. Next, there is a cut to the camera shooting a set of sewing tools and supplies, and then to a woman measuring the waist size of her dress. The video then cuts to a piece of fabric being pinned against the ground. Once it is pinned down, a curved line is drawn on it using a ruler. Next, there is a cut to the woman cutting fabric into the two halves, turning the top layer inside out, and cutting a curved piece out. The woman then lays the fabric flat on the ground. This is followed by the woman cutting a straight piece on the left side, and using her cell phone to get a better picture of the piece as the video ends.
The video is filled with a lot of color: The woman's black and white polka dot blouse, the black skinny jeans she is wearing, the white measuring tape with blue markings and the teal and pink floral patterned skirt she is modeling. The video is also very fast-paced and the person shooting the video is barely visible at all.
The woman twirls around to display a skirt, then measures her waistline with a measuring tape, and then cuts a piece of fabric using scissors.
The video is set against some buildings. There is a wooden fence in one shot, some green trees in the second shot, and then a white wall in the third shot. The floor is a gray concrete that runs throughout the video. There is also some other scattered materials that are left on the ground at the end of the video that are only partially visible.

summary.brief: A woman models a teal‑pink floral skirt, measures her waist, and cuts fabric pieces for a DIY circle skirt.
summary.detailed: The segment begins with a fast‑paced clip of a woman twirling in a teal‑pink floral mini‑skirt, showing it from several angles. It then cuts to a table of sewing supplies before returning to the woman, who wraps a measuring tape around her waist and notes the size. She spreads a piece of fabric on the gray concrete floor, pins it down, and uses a ruler to draw a curved line. She cuts the fabric into two halves, flips the top layer inside out, trims the curved edge, lays the material flat again, and finally slices a straight strip along the left side. The segment ends with her holding a phone to get a close‑up view of the cut pieces.

action.brief: Cut fabric for a circle skirt

Finally she stands, lifts the skirt, twirls, and dances to show off the finished skirt.

The person measures a length across the fabric using the tape and then cuts out the shape with a pair of scissors. This action is repeated and a final, larger cut is made across the fabric. The video then cuts away again, leaving the woman cut out fabric on the ground as the video ends.
The woman is wearing a black and white patterned long-sleeved shirt and black pants. A yellow footstool and other pieces of fabric are visible on the left side of the shot. The shot is very dark, which means it is difficult to see several of the details of the video. The lighting is not particularly bright. The focus of the video is on the hands of the person and the fabric being cut.
The overall background is of a carpeted room. The walls and floor are of a light beige color. This gives the setting of the video a neutral feel. A large window casting a wide beam of bright natural sunlight through the room adds contrast and highlights the person's hands.

summary.brief: A woman measures, marks, and cuts a pink‑green floral fabric into a curved piece, then begins to wrap it.
summary.detailed: Seated on a light‑beige carpet, the woman wearing a black‑and‑white patterned long‑sleeved shirt and black pants spreads a pink‑green floral fabric on the floor. She first folds the cloth in half and folds the top layer back and forth. She then pulls a measuring tape across the fabric, places the tape at a corner and uses a marker or chalk to make circular marks that form a curved guideline. Holding the material steady with one hand, she cuts along the marked line with scissors, creating a half‑circle shape. She flips the fabric over and makes additional straight cuts along the bottom, top and side edges to free the piece, repeatedly repositioning the cloth and adjusting the scissors. After the cutting is complete, she lifts the cut segment, places it beside other pieces, and begins to wrap the fabric around a small object as if wrapping a present. Throughout, the camera shows close‑ups of her hands, the tape measure, the markings and the scissors, while a yellow footstool, a window with natural light and other fabric scraps remain in the background.

nodes.plm_caption:
This video features a woman folding a patterned piece of fabric and then sewing it in together using a sewing machine. She then sews elastic to the bottom of the piece.
The video is in colour, well lit and has a shallow focus and many cut unders. At the beginning the camera is handheld before becoming a static shot. summary.brief: The woman folds, pins, stitches, trims and ties a colorful fabric to finish the skirt.
summary.detailed: The segment begins with the woman seated on a gray floor, wearing black pants and flip‑flops, as she spreads a long strip of patterned fabric, folds it, rolls it tightly and pins the roll, then repeats the same steps on the opposite edge. She turns the rolled fabric right‑side‑out, folds the bottom hem and pins it in place. Using a white sewing machine she stitches the folded edges, moving the fabric back and forth and flipping it several times to close all seams around the perimeter. She adjusts a shoulder seam, pins the hem of a floral blouse‑like piece and continues sewing, repeatedly flipping the piece to stitch every side, then displays the finished stitched edge. Next she measures a length of the fabric with a flexible tape, creates a crease, folds and pins the material again while removing a strip of elastic from a flap, and cuts away excess strap material with scissors. She then ties two white strings around the garment, making decorative knots, sews a fabric strap with tassels onto a separate white patterned sweat‑pant piece, and finally unfolds another piece of fabric, aligns and trims its corners before attaching the pieces together, completing the construction of the skirt.

action.detailed: Fold the patterned fabric, pin the edges, run it through a sewing machine to stitch all folds and hems, trim excess straps, and tie the finishing strings to complete the skirt.
